latest_release.name: Release v3.70.0
latest_release.body:
# Changelog

## [3.70.0] - 2026-11-13

### ✨ Features
- **postgresql**: Verify physical backups with CloudNativePG ([0489156](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/0489156f42cadb9e8535fda825e9f4c07913f42d))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **tests**: Make WAL boundary decoding fixtures deterministic ([6f9da40](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/6f9da404608997f4d032bef300065592c048ece1))
- **tests**: Keep outage backup transfers active during switchover ([bd5f8d5](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/bd5f8d577a02f2abea9cc2ceb4186c9524cce5da))
- **ci**: Apply Python step selection to the pre-commit subcommand ([6115feb](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/6115feb455f90b81e463432de4cf2c2386c36413))
- **tests**: Establish routing outages before primary switchover ([74d02d8](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/74d02d85aca23acaed978967e88abc46d2402546))
- **ci**: Isolate Python hook tests from unrelated checks ([bc0bccd](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/bc0bccd4bdda93961b483bf9c7c284c5e25f7a30))
- **hooks**: Run Semgrep before commits ([5fcf7ff](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/5fcf7ffc52d4ffcf942969d99f40f42b8a1ab9d5))
- **databasus-backups**: Clarify recovery inputs and startup diagnostics ([f689c18](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/f689c1830c6285533ad54e37789de71a856b2bfe))
- **website**: Handle unavailable hero statistics ([efe9541](https://github.com/databasus/databasus/commit/efe9541607bad7a4058ee7b871d297ef8ea3cb13))

### 🐳 Docker
- **Image**: `databasus/databasus:v3.70.0`
- **Mirror**: `ghcr.io/databasus/databasus:v3.70.0`
- **Platforms**: linux/amd64, linux/arm64
